description: This Council has been asked for its observations on an application submitted to Westminster City Council (26/04097/FULL) for: Variation of conditions 4, 16, 23, 31, 39, 40, 41, 42, 43 of planning permission dated 23rd July 2024 (RN:23/07119/FULL) for the Variation of Condition 1 (approved plans) of planning permission dated 11 May 2022 (RN:18-09727-FULL) as amended by two non-material amendments (23/04588/NMA & 23/06258/NMA) for Demolition of existing buildings at Nos 28-34 Queensway and Olympia Mews and redevelopment of site by erection of a six storey, plus basement level, building comprising Class E retail floor space and residential flats (Class C3) and erection of a replacement two storey building for use as Class E office floorspace, together with associated landscaping. Namely, Introduction of greater flexibility of use of the Olympia Mews building: Variation of condition 16 to become a compliance condition in relation to noise assessment; Variation of condition 23 (parts B and C) to become a compliance condition in relation to conservation method statement; Variation of conditions 31, 41, 42, 43, with submission of relevant information to amend this to become a compliance condition, in relation to all planting and soft landscaping across the scheme; Variation of conditions 39 and 40, with submission of relevant information to amend this to become, a compliance condition, in relation to tree protection and arboricultural monitoring; Design changes to three apartments, the communal garden area, and landscaping strategy.
site_name: Development site at Olympia Mews and 28 to 34, Queensway, London, W2
